# Ujjwal Roy

> AI strategist, founder and policy advisor. Ujjwal Roy engineered chips at Intel and Micron, founded ScaleBuild AI to turn AI into revenue, helped shape Nepal's first National AI Policy, and is the Founding President of the World AI Alliance, building AI that is fair and accountable for all.

Official website: https://ujjwalroy.com

## Who he is
- Roles: AI visionary, AI advisor, product strategist, business growth expert, operator
- Formerly at: Meta, Micron, IBM, Intel
- Building with: ScaleBuild AI, World AI Alliance, Hyperscaler (https://hyperscalerai.co/)
- Policy: helped shape Nepal's first National AI Policy
